summary.description: 1-2 sentence summary of what was changed and overall code quality

production_readiness.description: 1-3 sentences: is this MR safe to merge to production? What must be fixed before merge vs what can be addressed later?

agent_summaries.description: One 1-2 sentence summary per review sub-agent, keyed by the agent's role in snake_case (e.g. security, performance, ticket_alignment). Include one key for EVERY sub-agent in the configured roster — the roster is defined in review-agents.json, not fixed here.

file.description: Relative file path from repo root

line.description: Line number in the NEW version of the file (must be a line that was changed in this MR)

title.description: Short one-line title of the finding

fix.description: Concrete fix recommendation, can include code snippet

resolved_findings.description: Discussion IDs from existing_threads.json where the issue has been fixed in current code

thread_replies.description: Replies to unresolved threads where a developer commented and the bot has not responded yet

discussion_id.description: GitLab discussion ID to reply to

general_replies.description: Replies to standalone developer MR notes (not in any thread). Post as new MR note mentioning the author.

note_id.description: ID of the human note being replied to (from human_notes.json) — required for retry dedup (<!-- reply-to: ID --> marker)

body.description: Reply body (markdown). Start with @username to mention the author. Quote the original comment with > prefix for context.
